reason: A is more internally coherent and testable: it specifies non-ideal solid/liquid CALPHAD coupling, atomistic treatment of short-range order and grain-boundary premelting, quantitative ±10% targets, applicability limits, and a direct multi-alloy falsification experiment. B is similar but its claimed few-percent precision is unsupported and inconsistent with a falsification threshold of ~10% for only a majority of alloys, while its derivation of liquid thermodynamics from structural snapshots and DSC is less clearly defined.
